# nDm — Nova Dádiva da Madeira (ajuda.seedwave.pt)

> Free step-by-step guides to public services in Madeira and Portugal, written by people who went through each process themselves (Igor Kartuzov, SeedWave). Every guide is available in Portuguese, English, Russian, Spanish and German. Sample forms use made-up data; deadlines, screens and wording come from real applications.

Language versions: the Portuguese page is at the path itself (e.g. /cesd/); other languages add /en/, /ru/, /es/, /de/ (e.g. /cesd/en/).

## Guides

- [European Health Insurance Card (CESD / EHIC) — when Segurança Social Direta refuses](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/cesd/en/): the card is free and valid 3 years. If the online form says "Atualmente não reúne condições para solicitar o CESD por esta via", apply through e-Clic ("Esclarecer dúvidas sobre a minha situação"), send forms GIT-53 and MG2 plus a copy of the residence permit, sign with Chave Móvel Digital (GIT-53 page 3 position 12; MG2 page 1 position 15). Not valid for non-EU nationals in Denmark, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland.
- [Where is my AIMA case? The official tracker (contactenos.aima.gov.pt)](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/aima/en/): AIMA has a case tracker with eight stages (Submetido, Em análise, Em decisão, Decisão final, Cartão em produção, emitido, enviado with CTT code, entregue). Get the link via the contact form: subject "Consulta e acompanhamento do processo", subtype "Qual o estado do meu processo?", e-mail code, then seven personal fields (name, birth date, nationality, e-mail, phone, passport number, residence permit number "N.º AR / TR"). The link is permanent. "Pedido não aceite — no case found" usually means the system is down: retry next morning. The tracker shows the decision months before the Portal de Renovações.
- [Where is my Chave Móvel Digital? Log in in three steps](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/cmd/en/): the Chave Móvel Digital is not a card or an app; it is the mobile number plus the PIN (4–8 digits) chosen at activation. Log in: choose the «Chave Móvel Digital» tab, enter number and PIN, tap «Autorizar», enter the 6-digit code from SMS or the gov.pt app. Forgot PIN / blocked / new number: activate a new key over the old one in the gov.pt app (face recognition) or at an Espaço Cidadão. The signature PIN is separate; it switches off after 5 wrong attempts and is reactivated on autenticacao.gov.pt.
- [Rent up to €2,300: 10% tax instead of 25% — calculator](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/renda/en/): since 2026 (Decreto-Lei 97/2026, art. 45-C EBF) Portuguese residential rental income up to €2,300/month (2.5× minimum wage, updated yearly) is taxed at an autonomous 10% rate instead of 25%, for income earned 2026–2029. €1 over the cap and the whole rent is taxed at 25%. Break-even: a landlord asking €2,301–2,760 nets more by lowering to €2,300 (e.g. €2,500 at 25% = €22,500 net/yr vs €2,300 at 10% = €24,840). Companies (IRC): 50% of such income excluded. Separate 0% regime (RSAA) has much lower municipal caps.
- [Madeira resident card in SIMplifica (Cartão de Residente)](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/cartao/en/): free hiking trails for residents and the Porto Santo subsidy, screen by screen.
- [Booking a hiking trail in Madeira (SIMplifica)](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/trilhos/en/): residents at 0 € and visitors in one request.
- [Social mobility subsidy for flights Madeira — mainland (Subsídio Social de Mobilidade)](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/subsidio/en/): how to get part of the ticket back, five portal screens; also [money and amounts](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/subsidio/dinheiro/en/), [rejected claims](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/subsidio/rejeitado/en/), [family trips](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/subsidio/familia/en/).
- [Lei 23/2026 — the 400 € ceiling removed](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/lei-23-2026/en/)

## Ask, share, offer

- [Speak up / Dê-se a conhecer](https://ajuda.seedwave.pt/participar/en/): ask a question, share what worked, report a free programme or benefit you found, propose an idea, say you are looking for work or offer a service (dog walking, car repair, renovation help, translation…). Answered personally by Igor Kartuzov.
